plan.notes: Official 'Biology: General Biology Emphasis' four-year plan PDF, Department of Natural Sciences (comprehensive major, no minor required). All 8 term grids transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (15-16/15/14/16/14-16/17/15/14); grand total 120cr at transcribed minima. Credit ranges transcribed at minimum (Term 1 math choice 3-4 at 3cr; Term 5 elective 3-5 at 3cr). Slash lecture/lab codes kept as printed (04-106/107 etc.). OR-choice groups transcribed at first-listed option with alternatives in choice notes. Official prerequisites transcribed verbatim (raw). Block electives: at least one course from each of Blocks A-D totaling 24+ hrs; 40 hrs upper-division required - see advisor. Plan PDF has no revision stamp; live official version retrieved 2026-10-09.
